items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Babe Ruth, he used to come in there.

ctx.x: You know, when he come to Boston Opera House he'd live in a hotel and then he'd come down Sundays. He'd come down Sundays to enjoy himself, one Sunday I went
hunting and I didn't catch a thing, and when he left -- when I come there he had left a note, don't go hunting on my day. All the big shots come down there. Babe Ruth, he used to come in there.
You don't know the name of the restaurant. I know Mrs. Eggleston owned it.
